lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
viewer-init: 218 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 205 B, vue-demi 13 B.
All 2 pages load the same 1 file: 22,410 B raw, 3,932 B gzip, 30.5 % of the smallest page (viewer-main, 73,536 B).
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,691 B on the viewer-init page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (89 packages, 934 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
